p.t: The King's Guard: Serving the Crown
p.d: The Household Division prepare for the first King's Birthday parade in over 70 years, and two cavalry soldiers face a make-or-break final test to qualify as Tank Commanders

p.t: The King's Guard: Serving the Crown
p.d: Cameras follow the Household Cavalry to Edinburgh where they prepare for what's known as the 'Second Coronation' - a national service of thanksgiving to celebrate the accession of King Charles to the throne. After one of the busiest ceremonial seasons in its 360-year history, the King's Guard let off some steam before the event, with their own unique interpretation of the Highland Games

p.t: Inside Windsor Castle: A Royal Residence
p.d: A look at how Queen Victoria and Prince Albert made the castle their home, with the monarch's consort updating it with a modern sewer system and 139 flushable toilets. Xand Van Tulleken tries out the Victorian facial fashion fad that had Victoria all a flutter at Windsor, while JJ Chalmers reveals the surprising tradition that spread across the world and Raksha Dave finds out what pulled the queen out of her grief after Albert died

p.t: Inside Windsor Castle: A Royal Residence
p.d: JJ Chalmers finds out about a huge party staged by Edward VII that saw 8,000 revellers on the East Lawns and ended up with people pocketing castle cutlery as souvenirs. Plus, a look at Edward VIII's abdication after just 325 days on the throne, while Raksha Dave reveals what the teenage Princess Elizabeth got up to during the Second World War

Katie Nicholl and Jo Elvin present debate, insider analysis and insights on the royal family, with regular contributions from the King's former butler Grant Harrold and a host of authors, experts and commentators from around the world

England v Sri Lanka. Coverage of the third T20 in the three-match series, which takes place at Emirates Old Trafford in Manchester. Sri Lanka have never beaten England in a T20 series before so will be hoping that they have the chance to do that for the first time in this match. However the hosts have won the last two T20 series against Sri Lanka 3-0 so it'll be a huge test for the visitors
National and international news
Kate Humble and Andy Torbet explore the mystery behind the loss of the sister vessel of RMS Titanic, which was sunk while deployed as a hospital ship during the First World War

p.t: Why Ships Sink: The Zeebrugge Disaster of '87
p.d: On March 6, 1987, the Herald of Free Enterprise ferry set off from the Belgian port of Zeebrugge with 539 passengers and crew on board, but 20 minutes into its journey it started to list uncontrollably and 90 seconds later it had capsized. The coastguard and local ships mounted a desperate rescue mission, but 193 people died despite their efforts. This documentary reveals the series of catastrophic errors that led to the disaster, with testimony from crew and passengers who were aboard

p.t: Buckingham Palace: A Year in the Life
p.d: A behind-the-scenes look at the royal residence over the course of a year, beginning with the secrets of palace life during the summer season. From the splendour of the famous garden parties and the spectacle of Trooping the Colour to the King's Birthday Honours, state room opening and staff trips down hidden corridors, the programme uncovers the extraordinary stories behind life at Britain's most famous royal palace

Richard Madeley narrates this collection of clips featuring less-than-perfect moments from some of the nation's favourite TV shows and stars. They include Phillip Schofield and Holly Willoughby on This Morning, Dick & Dom in Da Bungalow, Tenable's Warwick Davis and Anne Robinson on The Weakest Link

p.t: Hughie Green: The Rise & Fall of Mr Saturday Night
p.d: The story of one the UK's most controversial, successful and ruthless TV personalities, from his early days as a child star, to his power moves in the early days of commercial TV, to his rebirth as the Simon Cowell of his day as host of talent show Opportunity Knocks. The documentary also examines how he kept quiet an affair with the wife of his rival Jess Yates, only revealing that he was the father of TV presenter Paula Yates after his death
Teleshopping for all things cruise-related, including the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals

p.t: Amazing Railway Adventures with Nick Knowles
p.d: Nick embarks on a railway journey across the extraordinary landscapes of Peru to Machu Picchu. Starting at Puno on Lake Titicaca, his journey takes him to the highest point on this railway line (and the fourth highest train station in the world) at La Reya
Shondie treats a young Welsh terrier travelling with its owners from Germany. David takes care of a canine tourist with the sniffles, while Tom prepares to operate

Jim and Lisa direct an intelligence-led strike, with the suspects on the move and believed to be in possession of a handgun and ammunition. Five armed-response vehicles and a dog van form the convoy performing a boxing-in manoeuvre on two vehicles simultaneously, and a search of one of the cars throws up a few surprises. The knife-crime team targets drug hotspots, while a pursuit in Worksop sees Jay Simms tail a suspected car thief into a housing estate

Armed response officers join up with colleagues from the knife crime team to smoke out a lad who was seen brandishing a 12-inch blade on a residential estate. Meanwhile, several units hunt down a driver who's been running red lights, speeding at over 100mph and caused a crash while driving the wrong way on a dual carriageway
Officers join the National Police Air Service to stop two suspects in a car believed to be on cloned plates - but that doesn't prevent the driver taking the pursuit into fields
James and Dan race to assist colleagues who are pursuing a stolen, speeding car, while the Tactical Support Group heads up a dawn raid, targeting a man with links to organised crime

A high-speed night-time pursuit in Bradford heightens tensions in the local community, with outnumbered cops facing the prospect of a potential riot. An apparently routine stop takes a serious turn as the vehicle pulled over is thought to contain a firearm and the unarmed officers must hold their nerve as they wait for a specialist team to join them. Jamie Theakston narrates

A high-speed chase in Bradford's crowded streets ends very suddenly and the driver claims he just wants to get home to eat his takeaway while it is still hot. But is that the whole story? In Harrogate, a volatile drink-driver's rapid mood swings prove a test for the cops, while a large stash of cannabis is found at the scene of a major collision, which has left one person with life-threatening injuries. A couple suspected of dealing drugs are chased down and taken to the station, where they provide the traffic team with contrasting reactions to being held in custody. Jamie Theakston presents

Thieves dragging a stolen generator on one wheel along town and country roads cause chaos, smashing the barriers on a closed level crossing and coming close to causing a train crash. A van with a surprising load is tracked using state-of-the-art technology in a game of cat and mouse, and a high-stakes hunt for a stolen van and mini-digger on the M1 nearly leads to carnage. Jamie Theakston presents

A murder suspect is pursued and trapped in Bradford by a task force of traffic cops and officers from a homicide unit. Meanwhile, another squadron of cars is deployed to catch a speeding car-theft suspect, whose risk-taking only ends when he hits a tree. Across the county, the cops are forced to intervene when a drink-driver is attacked by residents who want revenge for the damage he has done to their parked cars. Jamie Theakston presents

Terri, Bindi and Robert prepare Croc One, Steve Irwin's research ship, for a special mission to release an endangered sea turtle back into the wild

Villalobos throws a Halloween party to raise money for the rescue. An old friend returns and Lizzy struggles to rescue a stray dog in the middle of the night
Jackson Galaxy deals with violent feline Sebastian, who is putting a newborn in jeopardy, and door-opening wildcat Zeus, who keeps threatening to leave his owner
Jackson Galaxy deals with a tantrum-prone cat that lives in fear of the other two felines living in the same home. He also tutors a bouncer on how to handle his misbehaving cat

An interview with Bird, the Brown brothers' sharp-shooting sister, in which she answers fans' questions and shares her favourite memories of growing up in the wild
Donut Mania is Brett's newest business venture and they are having a grand opening, so Wayde and the team want to congratulate him with a surprise fish tank

The story of a giant otter cub rescued and raised by Brazilian naturalist Carolina Vargas. The creature has to be bottle fed, learn how to hunt fish and be taught how to survive the predators of the world's largest wetland, the Pantanal in South America

The wildlife cameraman sets out on an adventure with his wife Marguerite Smits Van Oyen and daughter Savannah to experience life on the Shetland Islands for a year. Arriving in the summer of 2008, Simon searches for an orca whale, sets up a hide to observe Arctic terns and teaches his daughter how to spot gannets. As winter arrives, the weather begins to cause problems when they are marooned by high winds and tides

David Attenborough examines the origins of humans, focusing on how they are the most adaptable and influential form of life that has evolved, and explores caves in southern France containing Stone Age paintings. He also travels to Papua New Guinea to find hunter-gatherers who have never before set eyes on white people

Socialite Marguerite 'Meg' Steinheil is found tied up in her bed, with her husband and her mother discovered to have been murdered in the next room, and Commissaire Cochefert and Inspector Jouin are suspicious of her witness statement. Third and final instalment of the period crime thriller, sequel to Paris Police 1900 and 1905, starring Jérémie Laheurte. In French

A torn-up card provides police with a lead in the case of the Steinheil home invasion, but their resources are stretched when a gunman attempts to assassinate Alfred Dreyfus. Journalist Marcel Hutin ingratiates himself with Jouin, who provides him with a copy of Adolphe Steinheil's autopsy report. In French

At the end of a long book-signing tour, Martin Scarsden hopes for a peaceful holiday with his partner Mandy Bond, who is already staying at the local yoga retreat in his home town of Port Silver. On the drive there, he is perplexed by a strange call from his childhood friend Jasper. Australian drama, starring Luke Arnold

As Martin continues to explore the events surrounding Jasper's murder, he helps Mandy deal with the information that someone, possibly Jasper, drugged her. In town, Martin bumps into his uncle Vernon and has pangs of guilt about an old betrayal

p.d: Part two of two. Helen Czerski explores the extraordinary messages carried by sound waves, and how they can help humans gain a better understanding of the world around them

A look at how scientists are challenging traditional perceptions of sharks, with breakthroughs regarding the creatures' intelligence and social skills presenting them in a surprising new light. The programme also highlights some researchers' beliefs that studying the predators could help to solve some of the most pressing medical challenges of the 21st century. Narrated by Paul McGann

p.t: Crossing England in a Punt: River of Dreams
p.d: Tom Fort embarks on a 170-mile journey down the River Trent in his own custom-built punt. The presenter encounters the power stations that generate much of the nation's electricity, meets veterans of the floods of 1947 and learns about a Bronze Age boatman who made a life on the banks as he discovers the waterway's 3,000-year history

Water has always been the driving force in East Anglia - its ebb and flow has shaped the fenland. The ancient wetlands once covered hundreds of square miles, but today, well over 90 per cent has been drained and converted into farmland. Every winter, thousands of whooper swans return to the flooded pastures of the Ouse washes from their Arctic breeding grounds. On the Welney Wetlands, spring sees 'mad' march hares boxing over mates. It was once thought these bouts were male hares boxing for dominance, but it is often the females throwing the punches to fend off the attentions of over-eager suitors. Narrated by Toby Jones

p.t: The Riviera: A History in Pictures
p.d: Part one of two. Actor Richard E Grant follows in the footsteps of artists who lived and painted on France's Cote d'Azur, renowned for its sunny climate. The first edition focuses on the relationship between modern art and the location's development as an international tourist haven. Cezanne, Monet and Renoir were captivated by the light and colour of the landscape in the 19th century and their resultant work advertised the region's beauty. Meanwhile, the area's vivid hues inspired Henri Matisse to adopt a new palette that set modern art on the route to abstraction

When Paul's car-boot sale fail to bring in any money, the Jessops are delighted to be offered a free family meal by Alf, Sue's new boyfriend, at his Italian restaurant. While Sue plies the family with food from Alf's kitchen, and Rachel starts Italian evening classes, Paul and Sam agree to help Robin learn more about Cherry's new estate agent boyfriend, by going undercover. By the time the big family meal rolls around, however, Alf begins to suspect that Sue is more interested in feeding her family and friends than she is in him, and Paul is put on the spot by Iain's estate agent colleague

Paul resumes learning to drive in time for the family holiday, as suggested by newly single Robin - just as Rachel learns that Amy has packed in her plan to go to university to be with Maya. On holiday in Scotland, some while later, with Paul still unable to drive, Robin reveals that he took the family there in order to intercept Cherry the day before her wedding, and the members begin to squabble. Just as everything looks hopeless for the Jessops, Paul is forced step in for an over-the-limit Rachel to keep the family holiday on the road and provide them all with a renewed optimism for the future

Joe Swift advises Newsround presenter De-Graft Mensah in Manchester, while growers in Scarborough and Bradford battle setbacks and forge friendships. Plus, Emmerdale stars Zoë Henry and Jeff Hordley reveal the domestic drama behind their much-loved allotment plot

Brian Cunningham looks at which trees can be planted that will cope with wet conditions, as well as which varieties should be brought indoors for protection as the nights get colder. Lizzie Schofield demonstrates how to take autumn seeds and cultivate for spring seedlings, while Carole Baxter is back with another one of her visits to a great Scottish garden, this week she is visiting a plot in Wester Ross

It's sewing machines at the ready as the finalists tackle three challenges in their bid to be crowned this year's winner. They begin by following the pattern for a bow tie and a cummerbund, which proves quite tricky owing to the amount of clips and clasps involved. In the transformation challenge, they turn tableware into chic beach club fashion, before creating made-to-measure outfits for their close friends on a theme of metamorphosis. Three finalists, three challenges - but only one will be crowned the latest champion. Presented by Sophie Willan

Iain Stirling challenges the four semi-finalists to create towering sand sculptures on St Andrews beach as they try to claim a spot in the final. With drama, collapses and plenty of sand-fuelled fun as the clock ticks down from yellow flag to red, who will soar into the final, and who will crumble under the weight of their own ambition?

Charlton Athletic v London City Lionesses (Kick-off 12.30pm). All the action from the match at The Valley. Charlton were promoted to the top flight last term after defeating Leicester City on penalties in the promotion play-off. The Lionesses played their maiden campaign in this division last term, acquitting themselves well as they finished in sixth place, and they have since strengthened their squad with star names such as Alexia Putellas and Mapi León

Leonard Bernstein and Stephen Sondheim's Oscar-winning musical adapted from their own stage production, starring Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno and George Chakiris

Warrington Wolves v Hull Kingston Rovers (Kick-off 5.30pm). Commentary on the second Elimination play-off, held at Halliwell Jones Stadium. Rovers are the reigning champions, but only managed sixth in the table during the regular season this time around, so hosts Warrington will fancy their chances this evening after their third-place finish

Action from day three of the DP World Tour tournament, which takes place at Wentworth Club in Virginia Water, Surrey. Alex Noren will be aiming to defend the title that he won here 12 months ago and if he was to succeed here he would join Colin Montgomerie and Bernhard Langer in winning this event on three separate occasions. England's Nick Faldo holds the record of winning the tournament four times after his victories in 1978, 1980, 1981 and 1989

Weasels are often portrayed as villains and associated with bad behaviour. In an attempt to determine whether that assessment is correct, this documentary employs the use of over 50 hidden cameras to follow the adventures of first-time stoat mum Bandita as she raises her kits in a unique weasel wonderland. Cameras capture the creatures interacting, revealing the true nature of the weasel family - feisty and fearless. Narrated by Julie Walters

The country singer's complete set on the Pyramid Stage at Worthy Farm in the now-traditional legends spot on Sunday afternoon, featuring Jolene, Coat of Many Colours, 9 to 5, Islands in the Stream and I Will Always Love You

p.t: Sisters in Country: Dolly, Linda and Emmylou
p.d: A look at how the careers of Dolly Parton, Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris took off in the 1970s with very distinct takes on country music, before they came together to collaborate on the album Trio in 1987. The artists talk about uniting as harmony singers, focusing on how their alliance made them pioneers in bringing different music worlds together and raising the game for women in the country tradition. Narrated by KT Tunstall

A selection of archive appearances by the country superstar on the BBC, including performances of Jolene, 9 to 5, Islands in the Stream and Here You Come Again. This collection showcases the enduring songwriting talents and sense of humour that first made Dolly's name back in the 1970s

England v Sri Lanka. Action from the final game in the three-match series, which took place at Emirates Old Trafford in Manchester. Sri Lanka had never beaten England in a T20 series before so will have been hoping to have the chance to do that for the first time in this match. However, the hosts have won the last two T20 series against Sri Lanka 3-0 so it promised to be a huge test for the visitors

A young Jewish boy who was secretly baptised by his nurse is taken from his family by the Catholic church in 1850s Bologna. Italian period drama, starring Paolo Pierobon, Fausto Russo Alesi and Barbara Ronchi

p.t: The UnXplained: Mysteries of the Universe
p.d: Earth's neighbour Venus has volcanoes, clouds of acid rain and a surface temperature hot enough to melt lead. Experts contemplate whether this makes Venus Earth's 'evil twin'

Unexplained phenomena occurring across North America's National Parks. This episode focuses on Big Bend National Park in Texas, where a series of incidents has left some experts convinced of secret alien activities taking place there

Unexplained phenomena occurring across North America's National Parks. This episode explores the apparent forces living in the secret underworld of Death Valley National Park on the California-Nevada border, where a series of deaths and disappearances have taken place
A look at Cleveland National Forest, where reports of gun-wielding ghosts, savage creatures and otherworldly portals are rife
A trip through the ginormous forest in Arizona. Strange encounters rumoured to have happened there include an alien abduction

Drones explore strange geological occurrences, unique man-made structures, curious creatures and lost civilizations. This episode focuses on mysteries found in desert landscapes, featuring a constant inferno in Turkmenistan, mysterious circles in the Namibian desert and secret electric blue ponds in Utah

Cameras capture the world from fresh and exhilarating perspectives. This episode features a remote island linked to one of the world's most famous aviation mysteries, thousands of shipwrecks in the Bermuda Triangle and a history lost and found in the South Pacific

A look at how the discovery of Tutankhamun's largely intact tomb in 1922 was arguably more significant than his short reign as a pharaoh. He was buried in a golden coffin surrounded by 5,000 priceless treasures, including animal statues, jewellery, clothes, weapons and even toys

Ancient Egyptian queens who have shaped history, featuring an assessment of their enduring legacies. This programme looks at the life of Queen Tiye, wife of the Egyptian pharaoh Amenhotep III and mother of pharaoh Akhenaten

The presenter dives deeper into Egypt's mysteries, exploring the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. Travelling south, he visits the intricately designed Dendera Temple, where hieroglyphs and imagery hint at possible extraterrestrial connections. He concludes at the sprawling Karnak temple complex, marvelling at its monumental engineering, sphinx-lined avenues, and Hatshepsut's towering obelisk - wondering whether it's simply a monument or a channel for cosmic energy

She was the last pharaoh of Egypt and one of the most famous queens of all time, but Cleopatra's death in 31BC has been shrouded in mystery. Her body and final resting place have been lost without a trace for over 2,000 years, leaving the world's top archaeologists baffled
Actor Laurence Fishburne explores the fate of TWA Flight 800, a Boeing 747-100 that exploded and crashed into the Atlantic Ocean near East Moriches, New York, in July 1996
How, during the Second World War, Japan plundered a fortune worth hundreds of billions of dollars from occupied countries. To this day its whereabouts remain unknown

After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

p.t: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back

p.t: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
p.d: Gordon Ramsay visits Shanty on 19th, an iconic restaurant in the West End theatre district of Allentown, Pennsylvania, which has been a local presence for decades. However, its future success is under threat unless Gordon and his team can return the place to its former glory. They have just 24 hours to clean and remodel the interior as a bright and airy contemporary bistro that pays homage to the industrial history of its hometown and recreate the menu, working around the clock with the staff, who must learn how to make the new dishes and work together more effectively. The customers are asked to come back the next day to see the improvements. Will they think the new eatery is a star in the making?

A married couple from Chicago decide to steer clear of the usual festive celebrations and keep their cash for a holiday in the sun, prompting a busybody neighbour to call on the local community to pull out all the stops to make them change their minds. Festive comedy based on a novel by John Grisham, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Tim Allen, Dan Aykroyd and M Emmet Walsh

A publicity-seeking actress with an urge to be famous comes up with a plan to make a name for herself. She rents a billboard in New York with her name and picture on it, and soon becomes an overnight sensation - despite not actually being famous for anything. Meanwhile, a wealthy playboy becomes infatuated with her, to the consternation of her film-maker boyfriend. Comedy, starring Judy Holliday, Peter Lawford and Jack Lemmon in his screen debut

A struggling actor's ambitious, no-nonsense wife throws him out and demands a divorce. Desperate to spend time with his children, he puts his talents to good use by donning drag and posing as a British housekeeper to get a job looking after them - unaware of the positive impact the character will have on his life and career. Comedy, starring Robin Williams, Sally Field, Pierce Brosnan, Harvey Fierstein and Mara Wilson

A politician is attracted to a dancer he meets at a pivotal moment in his life, but finds his every effort to get to know her is thwarted by a group of mysterious men. He realises these shadowy figures are manipulating him and moving him toward a predetermined fate, which he resolves to fight. Sci-fi thriller, starring Matt Damon and Emily Blunt

Account of the life of medieval Scottish hero William Wallace. After the slaughter of his father and brother, young Wallace is taken in by his uncle, who teaches him how to use not only his brawn but his brain - which he employs to great effect years later when he resolves to drive the English out of Scotland. Oscar-winning historical epic, directed by and starring Mel Gibson. With Patrick McGoohan, Sophie Marceau and Catherine McCormack
In 1940, two friends build a machine that can intercept radio and television broadcasts from the future. Co-writer/director Andrew Legge's sci-fi drama, starring Emma Appleton and Stefanie Martini

A debt-ridden paroled thief decides to pull off one last burglary before finally going straight. Adding to his stress level is his girlfriend - who knows nothing of his nefarious past. Crime drama, starring Richard Crenna, Angie Dickinson, Cameron Mitchell and Hurd Hatfield

A knight returning home from fighting in the Wars of the Roses returns home to discover his father has been murdered. A family friend fighting for the other side has been blamed for the crime, but the knight tries to prove his wicked uncle is responsible. Swashbuckling adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's novel, starring Louis Hayward and Janet Blair

Before going on to write classic fantasy books The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, orphaned author JRR Tolkien finds friendship, love and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts at school. Eventually his experiences during the First World War inspire him to create a world of hobbits and wizards. Biopic, starring Nicholas Hoult, Lily Collins, Pam Ferris, Craig Roberts, and Derek Jacobi

Oscar-winning musical version of the stage play based on Charles Dickens' classic tale about a lonely workhouse orphan who ends up on the cold streets of London, where he falls under the wing of petty crook Fagin and his gang of young backstreet thieves. Featuring the iconic songs Food, Glorious Food, Consider Yourself, As Long as He Needs Me and You've Got to Pick a Pocket or Two. Starring Ron Moody, Mark Lester, Oliver Reed, Jack Wild, Harry Secombe, Shani Wallis and Leonard Rossiter

Racing car driver and engineer Carroll Shelby is lured out of retirement during the 1960s, in a period where the sport is dominated by Italian companies. Ford Motors are hoping to revive their flagging fortunes by launching a racing division and securing a high-profile win at the prestigious Le Mans 24-hour race. Shelby takes up the challenge of headlining the plan to build a revolutionary new race car, but courts conflict within the company by recruiting unpredictable, short-tempered British driver Ken Miles to take the wheel. Fact-based drama, starring Matt Damon, Christian Bale, Jon Bernthal and Caitriona Balfe

A man who's given up on life following the loss of his wife and wants to end it all. When a young family moves in nearby, he meets his match in quick-witted Marisol, leading to a friendship that will turn his world around. Comedy drama, starring Tom Hanks, Mariana Trevino and Rachel Keller

Father Gabriele Amorth, chief exorcist of the Vatican, investigates a rundown abbey in San Sebastian. The owner, Julia, claims her 12-year-old son Henry has been possessed by a demon. Local priest Father Esquibel is unprepared to tackle the profanity-spewing malevolence, so Amorth lends his years of experience to the case. Horror, starring Russell Crowe and Daniel Zovatto

Charles takes her to an optometrist, but the news is not good - Mary's vision cannot be saved and she will soon go blind. The case of 21-year-old nursing student Maura Murray, who went missing in February 2004 minutes after being involved in a traffic collision. For no apparent reason she had driven 144 miles north from her campus and the accident was the second road incident she had suffered within two days

The disappearance of Michele Whitaker who vanished in August 2002 after hitching a ride from a South Carolina truck stop. Convinced no one would be troubled at her departure, she made a new life on America's west coast, and only contacted relatives after a friend made her aware of a missing persons inquiry in her name six years later

The case of lawyer Royal 'Scoop' Daniel, who vanished in 1997. It later became apparent the Colorado attorney had travelled to Mexico to evade charges of theft and commercial bribery, and it took almost five years to have him returned to America to face justice

p.d: Late one night in 1993, a California police officer was shot and killed during a routine traffic stop. The only witness was his 12-year-old nephew. However, he was too traumatised to tell police what he had seen

p.t: Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death

p.d: In 1993, a family was torn apart when a mother in Jacksonville, Florida went missing. The case stumped detectives, who believed that the truth about what happened to her was locked inside the mind of the missing woman's three-year-old son

Can new Dark Arts teacher Gilderoy Lockhart, a wizard well known for battling all manner of magical creatures, help uncover the mystery? The peace of an Oxfordshire village is shattered by the apparently motiveless shooting of a woman through her kitchen window. Twenty-four hours later, her next-door neighbour suffers a similar fate. As Morse searches for a link between the victims, he becomes embroiled in an increasingly bitter election contest at an Oxford college. Starring John Thaw, Kevin Whately, Richard Briers, Maggie Steed and John Shrapnel

The Cornish detective's silver wedding celebrations are interrupted by a fresh outbreak of crime on his patch. Five dead bodies have been found on board an abandoned lorry at the ferry terminal and a fugitive is on the run. Jack Shepherd, Helen Masters and Jimmy Yuill star

Unexplained killings rock the Bodmin community, giving rise to fears that the so-called 'beast', a monster enshrined in local legend, has returned to wreak fresh havoc. Kersey ventures up onto the moors to investigate and does not return - so Wycliffe is forced to go it alone. Jack Shepherd and Jimmy Yuill star

Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Ladbrokes Gold Cup from Ayr, plus racing from Newbury, where the Mill Reef Stakes is the highlight. Analysis comes from Megan Nicholls and Adele Mulrennan, with reporting by Matt Chapman and Natalie Green, and commentary from Mark Johnson

An organic bakery in the newly restored Larkton's Mill causes resentment in Lower Blissingham, with many of the old village businesses struggling, traffic having increased and rumours that owners Tom and Chrissie Larkton are planning to expand. Highwayman Inn landlady Denise Bantrig organises a protest group against the couple, and is supported by Maria, who runs the old village cafe and will not let her business go down without a fight. Their complaints are not taken too seriously until several people are dosed with a dangerous hallucinogenic at a Midsummer's Eve party, with Barnaby and Winter called in to investigate, and the situation escalates when a farmer is murdered. Crime drama, starring Neil Dudgeon and Nick Hendrix

The residents of the village of Elverton-Cum-Latterly gather for its annual dominoes tournament, but this year it has competition from a drag queen event to benefit charity. This creates friction and soon one of the dominoes players is found dead and it is up to Barnaby to find the culprit. Mystery drama, starring Neil Dudgeon and Nick Hendrix

Stourwick Hall has been owned and occupied by the Shirewell family since the sixteenth century - when Lucian, the eccentric heir to the estate, reveals that his family's tenure will be the Shirewells' last, the stage is set for a deadly game of power and revenge as Barnaby and Winter quickly discover that the Shirewell family has a complicated past.

The detective investigates the discovery of an unidentified teenage boy's body in a coastal town's shipyard, who is revealed to be listed as a missing person, having absconded from the care of his support worker. Vera discovers that the quiet community where he was found is plagued by a serious drugs problem - despite the fact that the only known dealer in the area has turned his back on crime. The victim could be the answer to the mystery, but a wall of silence surrounds his death. Mark Addy guest stars

Lewis joins Morse on a trip to Australia, but it is no holiday - they are pursuing a former supergrass who holds the key to a mystery back in Oxford. Going deep into the heart of the Outback, Morse soon begins to miss the comforts of home, particularly his regular tipple, although Lewis finds he has more in common with his Aussie brethren than he thought. Crime drama, starring John Thaw, Kevin Whately and Con O'Neill
Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection

The Oxford detective is given a book on Victorian crimes while languishing in hospital, and soon becomes obsessed with a murder committed in 1859. Convinced the three men hanged for the crime were innocent, he sets out to solve the long-forgotten case. Starring John Thaw, Lisa Eichhorn, Judy Loe, Matthew Finney, James Grout and Clare Holman

Captain Hastings and the Belgian supersleuth investigate a baffling gangland murder which draws them both into the underworld of London's Little Italy. Miss Lemon turns out to have a link with the victim's valet. Whodunit, starring David Suchet and Hugh Fraser

Part one of two. Pop busies himself organising a christening while awaiting the birth of his first grandchild - and still finds time to cast a beady eye over the contents of an elderly widow's home. Whimsical rural drama, starring David Jason, Pam Ferris, Philip Franks and Catherine Zeta-Jones

Notorious gangsters Bugsy Siegel and Lucky Luciano and their cronies make a daring bid to overthrow the dons of Twenties New York. Crime thriller, starring Christian Slater, Patrick Dempsey, Richard Grieco, Anthony Quinn, F Murray Abraham and Michael Gambon

Two men rob the Hazzard Bank, while Sheriff Coltrane, Deputy Enos and the Dukes are quarantined. Fast-paced adventure, starring Tom Wopat and John Schneider
Two cowboys' friendship is shattered by their love for the same woman, leading to conflict on opposite sides of the law. Western, starring Rock Hudson, Dean Martin, Susan Clark and Donald Moffat

Wagon-train scout Lon Bennett leads Basque settlers on a perilous journey to California, where they hope to establish a vineyard. However, Lon's open pursuit of Gabrielle, a member of the group, causes friction - particularly for her husband and his brother. Western, starring Susan Hayward, Jeff Chandler and Blanche Yurka

Fact-based drama, chronicling the rising tensions between British colonial forces and Zulu tribes in 1879, culminating in the massacre at Isandlwana in which more than 1,500 British soldiers died shortly before the attack on Rorke's Drift. Prequel to Zulu, starring Burt Lancaster, Peter O'Toole, Denholm Elliott, John Mills, Simon Ward and Nigel Davenport

When the owner of a southern cotton plantation is drafted into the army during the Second World War, he is unable to curb his arrogance and clashes with his sadistic captain, who makes it his mission to reform the private's wayward attitude. Drama, starring Robert Wagner, Terry Moore, Broderick Crawford and Buddy Ebsen

The resurrected warrior battles for survival against a host of supercharged troops controlled by an insane computerised opponent. Action adventure sequel, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme, Michael Jai White, Heidi Schanz and Kiana Tom

A fugitive is left for dead by his treacherous followers on a dangerous world full of lethal predators. He lures bounty hunters to the planet in the hope of killing them and stealing their spacecraft, but finds himself forced to work with them against an attack by the monsters at the top of the food chain. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Vin Diesel and Katee Sackhoff

A hunter and collector of rare and exotic animals bags a priceless white jaguar for a zoo, but the ship bearing his precious cargo has two predators caged in its hold - the cat, and a political assassin being extradited to the Unites States. After the assassin breaks free - and then frees the jaguar - the hunter feverishly stalks the ship's cramped corridors in hot pursuit of his prey, right up until the unpredictable climax. Action thriller, starring Nicolas Cage, Famke Janssen and Kevin Durand
A French anthropologist and his wife are stalked by a mysterious street gang who harbour a terrifying supernatural secret. Horror, starring Pierce Brosnan and Lesley-Anne Down
Buying goods from the comfort of home
The first destination of the week is the George Inn in Barton-upon-Humber, North Lincolnshire, where a relationship revelation over drinks causes waves among the guests

The B&B challenge continues at Cross Farm Cottages in Holmfirth, West Yorkshire, where Claire and son Cole reckon their homely style and rural setting will pip their rivals to the post. But Alex is not impressed with the Artex, while Malaya has a firm opinion about the mattress
Malaya Nayak welcomes his rivals to the New Valron Hotel in the Lancashire seaside town of Blackpool, where he hopes a tram ride along the seafront will win him a few points

Guest house owners visit the Spinney Homestay in Warwickshire, where Phil Harris and Maria Parker are confident their swish sense of interior design and the lakeside setting will find approval. The hosts organise a pedalo trip down the Avon, where the rivalry spills over into some raucous racing. Yet, at drinks in the evening, it's another pair who decide to stick their oar in

The holiday hosts meet one last time, to settle the scores and discover what they've been paid. First to face the music is Pete Storey and his partner Alex Muse, owners of the George Inn in Barton-upon-Humber, Lincolnshire. After dishing out some flooring feedback, a payment leaves Phil and Maria out in the cold. Dirty discoveries, the utter lack of praise and sleep problems are all on the agenda, alongside the continental breakfast. After some dramatic discoveries and frank exchanges, the winning host is finally announced

Clergyman Ken is planning a permanent move to the district of Larnaca in Cyprus, and he's asked his good friend Katie to help him with the search. He's been visiting friends in Cyprus for years and, now that he's retired from his role as a prison chaplain, he thinks it's the perfect time to move closer to them. With a budget of £80,000, Jasmine Harman is tasked with finding him the perfect place. She has five properties up her sleeve but will any of them be the answer to Father Ken's prayers?

Craig Rowe helps Lesley and Ken, who have downsized their house in the UK to free up some cash to buy a holiday home on the Caribbean island of Barbados. Property expert Craig shows them the best of what their £350,000 budget can secure

Lian and Dave are searching for a holiday home in Spain's Almería Province to enjoy with their 13-year-old son Dominic. Ben Hillman lines up five impressive properties for their £80,000 budget, but will any of them be the perfect place?

Single mother Siobhan Parkinson hosts the first dinner party of the week in Merseyside. Her guests are electrician Justin Sumner, hospitality assistant Lin Rearden, fitness instructor Jean-Jacques Silitto and student Ashley Burke, and she plans to win them over with a homely menu including chicken liver pate and slow-cooked lamb. Her efforts in the kitchen, however, are soon forgotten as insults start to fly with the arrival of her diners

Ashley Burke hosts the second party in Merseyside, bringing the diners to the home she shares with her mother, who has made herself scarce for the evening. Preparing for the event causes the hostess's enthusiasm to quickly wane, but she hopes her lack of experience in the kitchen will be ignored when she invites her fellow competitors to enjoy her oxygen bar

Fitness instructor Jean-Jacques Silitto hosts the latest dinner party in Merseyside. He is keen to impress his guests with a combination of fancy French food, a 'gym bunny' theme and an assault course so his fellow diners can work off their meal - an idea that fails to go down well with Ashley

Electrician Justin Sumner hosts the penultimate dinner party in Merseyside and is determined to impress his guests by creating a Chinese-themed menu from scratch. He also hires a cheesy crooner to serenade the group and hopes to win back Jean-Jacques' friendship following yesterday's antics

For Earth Day, Paddington would really like to plant a sapling. But what is a good place for an oak tree? Baaz would like to share a special Indian harvest festival with everyone, but he has forgotten the invitations.

Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
Paddington and his friends help PC Wells solve a mysterious case. Inspired by Aunt Lucy's special recipe, the Browns start a takeaway business from their home, but it proves to be hard work.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.

Chef wants to host dinner and a show, but struggles when he can't seem to get any of his magic tricks right. Chef aims to make an extreme snack for Henry's extreme cousin, but he accidentally makes his cauliflower bites too spicy!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

p.d: Kana manages to get a clean and fast job, while her friends have no choice but to do a muddy and slow one.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.

Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

A dog named Bella gets separated from her owner and embarks on an epic 400-mile journey to find her way back home. Family adventure, starring Ashley Judd, Jonah Hauer-King, and Edward James Olmos. Directed by Charles Martin Smith (The Untouchables)
Aviva and Koki make a catapult, while Chris and Martin set out to learn everything they can about grasshoppers and their jumping powers

Part two of two. Maria and her dad try to find out more about Luke's new parents, only to discover he has been kidnapped by the Slitheen. Normally, Sarah Jane would turn to her supercomputer for help, but gets a shock when Mr Smith turns out to be one of the bad guys
It's the inter-school tournament, and the Vipers might just win. Jessica is determined to spoil everything, and Aoife must use all her detective powers to keep the team together.
The stories making the headlines both at home and abroad during the past seven days
Sonny's world collapses, Tane sets a trap, and David's search for Beau ramps up
Zane and Alf's relationship begins to thaw, and Harper drops a bombshell
Alf refuses to budge, Dana makes a big decision, and Tane confronts Sonny

A high school athlete overcomes physical and mental challenges after making the all-male football team, but faces a hurdle when she questions her sexuality. Drama, starring Naomi Grace and Sharon Leal

Pastry chefs from hotels, restaurants and small businesses in Cardiff, Bristol, Norfolk, Brighton and London compete to be crowned best patisserie team in Britain. The teams face testing challenges judged by two world-class patisserie experts, Benoit Blin and Cherish Finden. For their first challenge, the teams must produce two different types of miniature classics - Tarte Piémontaise and the Jaffa Cake. They must make 24 perfect and identical items of each pastry in just three and a half hours

p.t: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby
p.d: Giles Coren and Monica Galetti travel to South America to work in Vira Vira, a hacienda hotel that overlooks an active volcano near Pucon, the adventure capital of Chile. Giles and Monica prepare a meal for guests, go trekking through the Chilean forests on horseback and hear how the chef has an abundance of Chilean produce for his recipes
Frank realises he needs to break up with Yasmin, Patel's gorilla rescue goes viral and Emily finds an unexpected benefactor in a celebrity businesswoman
Emily keeps her distance from Frank when her rich new benefactor visits, suspecting he will not play nice
A look ahead to the opening matches in the competition, including Kosovo v Republic of Ireland

p.t: Edward & Wallis: The Bahamas Scandal - Revealed
p.d: The story of the Duke and Duchess of Windsor's little-known years in the Caribbean during the Second World War, where as colonial governor and wife it was hoped they would be far from danger and the machinations of German agents in Europe. Using British government and FBI documents, this film uncovers in detail the Windsors' disastrous stay in the Bahamas, which included scandals of extravagant spending, prejudice, murder and deadly race riots

As America braces for a third year of war, British commanders launch campaigns to take Albany and Philadelphia. General Howe beats General Washington at Brandywine and Germantown, while the Continental Congress flees Philadelphia. However, the Americans' victory over General Burgoyne at Saratoga opens the door for France to officially support the US
An investment banker defrauds his employer and appears to get away with his crime - until an eagle-eyed accountant steps in. Ian Holm stars
The theft of a few pairs of gloves leads a man to a discovery that shatters his world. Drama, starring Janet Leigh and Tom Bosley
Two women strike up a friendship, but one appears to have highly questionable motives. Drama, with Cherie Lunghi and Carol Drinkwater
A young doctor continues to date a beautiful showgirl in spite of warnings that her three previous marriages ended badly for her past husbands
A remorseful detective vows to find the men who murdered his son, who followed in his footsteps and also became a police officer
Performances from the home of country music in Nashville, Tennessee, featuring Chris Young, Gary Sinise & the Lt Dan Band, and Sara Evans
A profile of the American actor and comedian, who starred in Good Morning, Vietnam and Dead Poets Society and won an Oscar for his role in Good Will Hunting

An aspiring writer falls for a seemingly happy-go-lucky woman living in the same apartment building, and is drawn to her unconventional lifestyle. However, he detects her quirky demeanour is masking a colourful past, while her mysterious visits to an imprisoned gangster have unexpected consequences. Romantic comedy drama based on Truman Capote's novel, with Audrey Hepburn, George Peppard, Mickey Rooney and Martin Balsam

A portrait of Hollywood icon Greta Garbo, exploring her fame, famous isolation and her decision to retire from acting. This documentary includes previously unseen archive footage, letters from Garbo, and re-enactments of her life. Narrated by Noomi Rapace

Concert film shot over the course of gigs at Les Arenes in Nimes and the Stadion Feijenoord in Rotterdam during the band's last concert tour. Mark Knopfler and the group perform tracks from their 1991 album On Every Street, as well as hits including Walk of Life, Money for Nothing, Wild Theme and Romeo and Juliet

p.t: Mark Knopfler: A Life in Songs
p.d: Documentary examining the career of the musician, featuring an interview in which he talks about the influence of his life and background on the songs he has written. The programme traces his working life, from his beginnings playing in pubs in Leeds in the 1970s, to his success with Dire Straits and writing of the Brothers in Arms album, as well as his world tour as a solo artist

A performance from the band's highly successful Black Ice world tour, recorded in the Argentine capital Buenos Aires in 2009, when they played to almost 200,000 people over three nights. Featuring classic tracks including Highway to Hell, Whole Lotta Rosie, Back in Black and You Shook Me All Night Long
Kelsea Ballerini, Ashley Cooke, John Foster and Ella Langley perform at the home of country music in Nashville, Tennessee

In 1984, the classic Deep Purple line-up of Ian Gillan, Ritchie Blackmore, Roger Glover, Jon Lord and Ian Paice reunited for the album Perfect Strangers and went on tour. This is the film of their concert in Melbourne, featuring performances of Highway Star, Strange Kind of Woman, Child in Time, Black Night, Speed King and Smoke on the Water
Music experts explore the music of Jethro Tull, one of the most commercially successful and eccentric progressive-rock bands Britain has ever produced
Drama, starring Paul Giamatti and Damian Lewis. In the aftermath of their previous confrontation, Chuck faces increased scrutiny from his office, while Axe weighs his options for retaliation
Axe publicly spars with a rival hedge fund manager, while Chuck attempts to find a case that may salvage his career
Bayliss returns to duty, only to discover the bosses have renovated the squad room in an attempt to make everyone forget the tragic events of last May. Kyle Secor stars
Sheppard and Lewis investigate the death of a man who has a twin brother, and his girlfriend quickly becomes the prime suspect. Starring Michael Michele and Clark Johnson
Gee and Ballard investigate a double shooting at a prominent sports doctor's home. Police drama, starring Yaphet Kotto and Callie Thorne

A woman gives the homicide unit a videotape recorded by her mystery-writer husband, alleging his literary agent is responsible for murdering him. Meanwhile, Munch and Bayliss investigate the death of an elderly woman apparently killed during a break-in. Gritty police drama, guest starring Patti D'Arbanville

The FBI is called in to help when a poisoner begins injecting bottles of wine with a lethal substance. Meanwhile, Ballard grows tired of being the subject of gossip and Munch refuses to share his personal problems with his colleagues. Gritty police drama, starring Richard Belzer and Callie Thorne

Period drama set against the backdrop of the American Gilded Age, following the fortunes of Marian, a young woman who moves from rural Pennsylvania to New York City after the death of her father to live with her wealthy aunt. Starring Louisa Jacobson, Christine Baranski and Denée Benton
Tom Raikes visits New York as Peggy seeks advice, Oscar van Rhijn homes in on Gladys Russell and drama rips through a charity bazaar
An unfortunate development finds George's new rail station under threat, and Marian continues to see Mr Raikes despite Agnes' warnings
In the aftermath of a tragedy, George agrees to help Bertha, and a visit has a lasting impact on the staff of Russell house
As Bertha, Marian and Aurora visit Dansville to hear Clara Barton speak, Marian's interest in Mr Raikes grows. Period drama, starring Louisa Jacobson
Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands. Drama, starring Howard Charles

Shaughnessy and Bennet capture Mohamad al-Owhali, who confesses to bombing the embassy in Nairobi after being interrogated by Chesney. O'Neill and Soufan search the home of a second suspect, Anas al-Liby, but do not have enough evidence to hold him. Stuart's minimal clearance at the CIA prevents them from building a stronger case. Arrogant analyst Martin Schmidt convinces the President to retaliate by bombing an al-Qaeda training camp in Khost, Afghanistan. Alec Baldwin guest stars, with Jeff Daniels, Peter Sarsgaard and Virginia Kull

Continuing to keep information from the FBI, Schmidt is fired from Alec Station. Diane makes an important discovery about the owner of the phone number al-Owhali gave Chesney. O'Neill searches for solace in his faith as his personal and professional lives crumble before him. Jeff Daniels, Peter Sarsgaard and Wrenn Schmidt star
Iris concocts an audacious plan to rescue Joy, involving a dramatic reunion with Cameron, then they are forced to flee with Alfie and Nico

Leonidas, fearless king of Sparta, leads 300 of his finest warriors into battle against the vast invading armies of the ruler of the Persian empire. As the outnumbered Spartans fight for their country, his queen, Gorgo, tries to rally support for her husband at home. Fantasy action adventure based on Frank Miller and Lynn Varley's comic-book series, starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, Dominic West, David Wenham and Rodrigo Santoro

Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Desperate to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards enters a deadly televised competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Director Edgar Wright's comedy thriller based on the Stephen King story, starring Glen Powell, Lee Pace and Josh Brolin

Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score. Thriller, starring Zachary Levi, Liam Neeson and Quincy Isaiah

Three years after the destruction of Jurassic World, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing are asked to return to the theme park to save its resident dinosaurs from the island's active volcano. During their mission, they uncover a conspiracy that may affect the entire planet. Action sequel, starring Chris Pratt, Bryce Dallas Howard, Rafe Spall and Toby Jones

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Incarcerated Special Forces veteran John Rambo is offered the chance for freedom by former commander Colonel Trautman if he takes up the offer to return to the jungles of Vietnam on a life-or-death mission to rescue American PoWs. During the course of the operation, he develops strong feelings for his guide, a female freedom fighter - but tragedy strikes, leaving him more determined than ever to exact a bloody and explosive revenge. Action adventure sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Julia Nickson-Soul, Steven Berkoff, George Kee Cheung, Andy Wood and Martin Kove

The masked hero returns to face the Penguin, a grotesque crime boss dwelling in the sewers who conspires with a corrupt businessman to make himself mayor. When the tycoon tries to kill his secretary, she returns as vengeful vigilante Catwoman, who soon forms an intense relationship with the dark knight in both their costumed and real identities. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer

A wandering swordsman is knighted for his fighting prowess at the court of King Arthur and his wife, Lady Guinevere. However, the new knight and the queen develop a dangerous and secret attraction for each other, while a neighbouring warlord threatens the downfall of the kingdom. Adventure, starring Richard Gere, Sean Connery, Julia Ormond and Ben Cross
Nature bites back in this week's edition of the Cinema List. From Anaconda to Jurassic World: Rebirth, expect plenty of teeth, claws, and scales

The war between the shape-shifting robots erupts once again, as the first of the evil Decepticons leads an attack on Earth to locate an ancient planet-destroying machine. Hapless teenager Sam Witwicky is caught in the middle of the ensuing conflict as he holds the key to discovering the location of the device. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

The heroic autobots discover that a spaceship from their own planet crashed into the moon decades ago, carrying their former leader and an incredibly powerful device. They must fight to defend the human race as their enemies the decepticons plot to use this machine to rebuild their own world and destroy the Earth. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with Shia LaBeouf, Josh Duhamel and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley

The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer

After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

With the web-slinger's identity now revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for magical help to undo the damage. However, a spell gone wrong unleashes dangerous foes from parallel universes on the world. Comic-book adventure sequel, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya and Benedict Cumberbatch, with Willem Dafoe, Jamie Foxx and Alfred Molina among the stars of past Spider-Man movies reprising their roles

Conservationist Sergei Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai, sets him on a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become Kraven, the world's most feared hunter. Fantasy adventure, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Russell Crowe and Ariana Debose

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer-director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

While exploring space for new worlds, a probe belonging to the Life Foundation discovers a comet covered in symbiotic lifeforms. Following the probe's return to Earth, journalist Eddie Brock investigates sinister trials being carried out by the corporation, and after being infected by an alien symbiote, develops superhuman strength and power. Fantasy adventure, starring Tom Hardy and Riz Ahmed

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

The shape-changing robots and their human allies face a confrontation with their original creator, who has brainwashed their leader and intends to save her own home planet by destroying Earth. To save the human race they must recover an ancient artefact from Arthurian legend - but their mission is threatened by old enemies as they uncover a terrible secret about the history of the world. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mark Wahlberg, Anthony Hopkins, Gemma Chan, Stanley Tucci and John Turturro

After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage
A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

In 1987, lonely Californian teenager Charlie Watson is traumatised by the death of her father and resentful of her mother Sally's relationship with new boyfriend Ronald. For her 18th-birthday she's given a yellow Volkswagen Beetle, which turns out to be the battle-scarred Autobot Bumblebee. Transformers prequel, starring Hailee Steinfeld, John Cena and Jorge Lendeborg Jr

Conservationist Sergei Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai, sets him on a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become Kraven, the world's most feared hunter. Fantasy adventure, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Russell Crowe and Ariana Debose

Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of meta-humans to stand against supervillain Steppenwolf, but despite the help of Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash, it may already be too late to save the planet. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot and Henry Cavill

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham

The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of self-imposed exile in a Buddhist monastery to visit Africa and help search for a sacred white bat. However, his unique investigative talents are tested to the limits as he faces a race against time to find the missing creature and prevent a tribal war. Comedy sequel, starring Jim Carrey, Simon Callow and Bob Gunton

The hapless fool is employed as a security guard for a British art gallery and is sent to Los Angeles to bring back a famous painting. Unfortunately, he finds himself mistaken for a renowned art professor and invited to make an important presentation. Mel Smith's British comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Burt Reynolds, Peter MacNicol, John Mills, Peter Capaldi and June Brown

The bumbling fool wins first prize in the church raffle - a trip to France and a video camera. His travels cause chaos as he disrupts a film shoot in Cannes, to the fury of its megalomaniac director, and is then accused of kidnapping a youngster. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Willem Dafoe, Emma de Caunes and Max Baldry

The friends from East Great Falls High reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming wedding. Though reluctant to invite Stifler to their big day, the happy couple relent - but regret their decision when he plans a bachelor party on the same evening Jim is due to meet the in-laws. The third instalment in the comedy series, with Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan, Seann William Scott, Eddie Kaye Thomas and Eugene Levy

A disorganised woman is asked to be maid of honour at her best friend's wedding. Taking charge of the prenuptial bridal celebrations, she resolves to give her pal and accompanying bridesmaids the time of their lives, but as her efforts slide into chaos she finds the wife of the groom's boss is keen to usurp her position. Comedy, with Kristen Wiig, Rose Byrne and Melissa McCarthy

Two rivals in the bookshop business fall in love over the internet, unaware they know and dislike each other in the real world. While things remain frosty in person, the pair's anonymous online relationship continues to blossom. Romantic comedy, starring Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Greg Kinnear, Parker Posey and Dabney Coleman.

Jim Levenstein and his old friends return to their home town for a high-school reunion. Struck by how much their lives have changed, they set out to relive the sexual misadventures of their adolescence, but only end up making bigger fools of themselves than they did as teenagers. Comedy sequel to the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan

Dim male model Derek Zoolander is stunned to find his career going downhill thanks to the arrival of an equally vacuous rival - but fails to realise he is merely a pawn in a dangerous game of international espionage and world domination. Comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Will Ferrell, Milla Jovovich, Christine Taylor and David Duchovny

Dim-witted supermodels Derek Zoolander and Hansel McDonald must step back into the spotlight and save the day when a maniacal villain starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson, with Penelope Cruz, Will Ferrell and Kristen Wiig

An American counter-terrorism unit travels around the world on the lookout for threats to global peace, causing much destruction to major world cities in the process. The biggest current menace is North Korean leader Kim Jong-il and an organisation much closer to home - the Film Actors Guild. Satirical puppet comedy, voiced by South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone
It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist

Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

A manager for an American courier service has to fend for himself when a plane crash leaves him stranded alone on a desert island. Initially panic-stricken, he overcomes his terror to survive for four years on his own before building a raft and setting off on an epic journey back home. Adventure drama, starring Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Lari White and Chris Noth

A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

Ray Stoker and his brother Jem have been estranged for 20 years, haunted by a shared history scarred with violence. Ray now lives in a primitive cabin in the woods in self-imposed exile while Jem has fought refuge in his faith and the love of his partner Nessa and their son Brian. An unexpected family crisis compels Jem to seek out Ray and face the ghosts of the past. Director Ronan Day-Lewis's drama, starring Sean Bean, Daniel Day-Lewis and Samantha Morton

A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

American fashion model-turned-war photographer Lee Miller is determined to document the truth of the Nazi regime, and in spite of the odds stacked against female correspondents, she captures some of the most important images of the Second World War. Fact-based drama, starring Kate Winslet, Andy Samberg, Alexander Skarsgard and Marion Cotillard

After a devastating loss, sharp-witted, defiant 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tells a story that spirals into a dangerous reality. Director Scarlett Johansson's drama, starring June Squibb, Erin Kellyman and Chiwetel Ejiofor

An idealistic sports agent produces a mission statement at work promising to treat clients fairly. Unfortunately, it costs him his job. Forced to set up an agency on his own, the only people prepared to stand by him are a lovelorn staff accountant and a footballer. Cameron Crowe's romantic comedy drama, with Tom Cruise, Renee Zellweger, Kelly Preston, Jonathan Lipnicki, and Cuba Gooding Jr, who won an Oscar for his performance

A single man gets the chance to turn his unhappy life around when his father reveals that they both have the ability to travel through time and change their personal history. He uses his newfound talent to try to improve his love life and win the heart of an American woman he has fallen for. Romantic fantasy comedy, with Domhnall Gleeson, Rachel McAdams and Bill Nighy

An unexpected family crisis compels Jem to seek out Ray and face the ghosts of the past. Director Ronan Day-Lewis's drama, starring Sean Bean, Daniel Day-Lewis and Samantha Morton
