Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

p.t: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
p.d: An eight-year-old girl experiences life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the final stages of the Bush War. Drama, written, directed by and starring Embeth Davidtz, with Lexi Ventner and Zikhona Bali

Rebellious American teenager Danny falls for innocent Australian girl Sandy during the summer holidays, but when he later finds out she is a new student at his school, he risks losing her love by trying to act cool in front of his friends. Romantic musical set in the 1950s, starring John Travolta, Olivia Newton-John, Stockard Channing, Jeff Conaway, Didi Conn and Sid Caesar

A shy English boy joins the senior class at Rydell High and immediately falls for the leader of the Pink Ladies. But she is only interested in tough guys, forcing him to adopt a dual identity as a mysterious biker. Musical sequel, starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Maxwell Caulfield, Lorna Luft, Eve Arden and Sid Caesar, with Didi Conn reprising her role as Frenchy from the original film

An idealistic sports agent produces a mission statement at work promising to treat clients fairly. Unfortunately, it costs him his job. Forced to set up an agency on his own, the only people prepared to stand by him are a lovelorn staff accountant and a footballer. Cameron Crowe's romantic comedy drama, with Tom Cruise, Renee Zellweger, Kelly Preston, Jonathan Lipnicki, and Cuba Gooding Jr, who won an Oscar for his performance

Dracula opens a luxury resort for monsters, to provide a refuge from terrified humans. His cosy sanctuary is disrupted when a normal man unwittingly checks in, and the situation is complicated when the unwanted guest takes a liking to the count's daughter. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg

Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done. The count is shocked to receive an unwelcome visit from his own father, who does not approve of his son's tolerance of humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg

Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez

A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

A bumbling secret agent becomes Britain's leading spy following the assassination of all the country's other espionage experts. Single-handedly he sets out to unmask a mysterious villain responsible for stealing the Crown Jewels - but no one is prepared to believe a sinister billionaire is the culprit. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, John Malkovich, Natalie Imbruglia and Ben Miller

A bumbling secret agent retires to a Tibetan monastery in disgrace after a mission goes wrong. He is lured out of seclusion by the chance to redeem himself when his former bosses seek his help in foiling an attempt to assassinate the premier of China. Spy comedy sequel, starring Rowan Atkinson, Gillian Anderson, Rosamund Pike and Dominic West

A sinister cyber attack reveals the identity of all active undercover agents in Britain. Hapless secret agent Johnny English is sent on a mission to the South of France to protect Queen and country, and find the mastermind hacker responsible. Third movie in the comedy series, starring Rowan Atkinson, Ben Miller and Olga Kurylenko

Penniless Charlie Bucket is one of five lucky children who find a golden ticket in a chocolate bar, winning a once-in-a-lifetime tour of eccentric recluse Willy Wonka's magical sweet company. Unfortunately, the other winners each face a grim fate when they start to misbehave. Tim Burton's children's fantasy, based on Roald Dahl's novel, starring Johnny Depp, Freddie Highmore, Helena Bonham Carter, and Deep Roy playing all the Oompa Loompas

A clumsy Viking boy longs to become a mighty dragon slayer and protect his village from the fearsome flying lizards, but his father thinks he is not up to the task. However, when he sets out to prove his worth, he ends up befriending a dragon, and realises his people may have misjudged the creatures. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Jay Baruchel and Gerard Butler
Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

An orphaned girl befriends a benevolent giant, who takes her off to a magical land, where they attempt to stop the man-eating creatures that are invading the human world. Steven Spielberg's fantasy adventure based on Roald Dahl's book, starring Mark Rylance, Ruby Barnhill and Penelope Wilton

The blue hedgehog, Knuckles and Tails reunite to face the might of the villainous Shadow, who possesses powers unlike anything they have seen before. Outmuscled on every front, Sonic seeks help from an unlikely source, Dr Ivo Robotnik. Fantasy adventure sequel based on the videogame, starring Jim Carrey, James Marsden and Tika Sumpter

p.t: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
p.d: An incompetent scientist finally invents something that works - a machine that turns water into food. When the device gets launched into the atmosphere, it has a strange effect on his town's weather, causing giant meals to fall from the sky to the delight of the residents - until it gets out of control. Animated comedy, with the voices of Bill Hader, Anna Faris and James Caan

p.t: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
p.d: A scientist believes he has saved the world from his invention, a machine that accidentally turned water into food. However, he learns the device is still active and has created a race of food/animal hybrids that he must stop from running wild across the world. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Bill Hader, Anna Faris and James Caan

A headstrong chicken and her fellow fowls ponder how to escape from a grim Yorkshire farm before the evil farmer's wife can turn them into pies. Luckily, help arrives in the form of a heroic American rooster who promises to show them how to fly. Nick Park's animated comedy, with the voices of Mel Gibson, Julia Sawalha, Miranda Richardson and Jane Horrocks

Incorruptible federal agent Eliot Ness is assigned the task of fighting organised crime in Prohibition-era Chicago and bringing the notorious crime boss Al Capone to justice. Aware crooked police are undermining his investigations, he puts together his own elite squad to take on the Mob. Brian De Palma's crime thriller, with Kevin Costner, Robert De Niro, Andy Garcia and Sean Connery, who won an Oscar for his performance

A New England seaside town's tourist season is turned into a nightmare by a giant killer shark. The local police chief's efforts to protect the public are thwarted by the greedy mayor, forcing him to join forces with a grizzled fisherman and an enthusiastic marine biologist to hunt and kill the monster predator. Steven Spielberg's blockbusting thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss and Robert Shaw, with an Oscar-winning score by John Williams. The film also won Academy Awards for Best Sound and Best Film Editing

The seaside resort of Amity is terrorised once again by a man-eating great white shark. While police chief Brody struggles to alert the townsfolk to the magnitude of the danger, a group of teenagers - including Brody's two sons - is adrift at sea in waters hunted by the shark. Director Jeannot Szwarc's thriller sequel, starring Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary and Murray Hamilton, with John Williams once more providing the acclaimed score

A shark is captured by divers and put on display in a Florida marine centre, where it ultimately dies. However, examination of the body reveals the seemingly fully-grown shark was actually a baby - and its enormous, ferocious mother soon comes looking for it. Thriller sequel, originally released in cinemas in 3D, starring Dennis Quaid, Simon MacCorkindale, Louis Gossett Jr and Bess Armstrong

A scrupulously honest detective investigates after a cop leaves a suicide note detailing corruption in the force and gangland connections, but gets taken off the case when his own wife is killed by the Mob. However, convinced the officers in charge are covering their tracks, he decides to go it alone. Fritz Lang's noir crime drama, with Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame, Lee Marvin and Alexander Scourby

Incorruptible federal agent Eliot Ness is assigned the task of fighting organised crime in Prohibition-era Chicago and bringing the notorious crime boss Al Capone to justice. Aware crooked police are undermining his investigations, he puts together his own elite squad to take on the Mob. Brian De Palma's crime thriller, with Kevin Costner, Robert De Niro, Andy Garcia and Sean Connery, who won an Oscar for his performance

A banker is wrongly jailed for his wife's murder and over the course of a life sentence he forms a close friendship with a fellow inmate. He also earns a position of trust as book-keeper to the corrupt prison governor - but makes an enemy of his benefactor as he tries to clear his name. Frank Darabont's drama, starring Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman, Bob Gunton, William Sadler, Clancy Brown and Gil Bellows

Sadistic young gang leader Alex leads a carefree life indulging his love of rape, violence and classical music. When he is finally arrested, he is subjected to a sinister form of aversion therapy that brainwashes him into being physically unable to use violence. However, on his release, he finds friends and family have turned on him, while others seek to exploit him to further their political ends. Drama, starring Malcolm McDowell and Warren Clarke

Small-time crook Tony Montana emigrates from Cuba to the US, determined to become rich and powerful. Admitted into the inner circle of a Miami drug lord, he ultimately takes over his boss's empire and even his wife. However, his paranoia and cocaine addiction begin to spiral out of control, while his enemies circle, waiting for the chance to bring him down. Gangster thriller remake, with Al Pacino, Michelle Pfeiffer and Robert Loggia

A banker is wrongly jailed for his wife's murder and over the course of a life sentence he forms a close friendship with a fellow inmate. He also earns a position of trust as book-keeper to the corrupt prison governor - but makes an enemy of his benefactor as he tries to clear his name. Frank Darabont's drama, starring Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman, Bob Gunton, William Sadler, Clancy Brown and Gil Bellows
From chart-topping singers to scene-stealing screen stars, this edition celebrates musicians-turned-actors, featuring Dreamgirls and Wicked: For Good

p.t: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
p.d: A blind man and his deaf friend go on the run to clear themselves of a trumped-up murder charge. However, all kinds of oddball characters are on their trail, determined to get hold of a top-secret microchip that the duo do not realise they have. Comedy, starring Richard Pryor, Gene Wilder, Kevin Spacey, Joan Severance, Alan North and Anthony Zerbe

Pregnant Mollie is dumped by her boyfriend, and sets out after the baby's birth to find a surrogate father for her infant son Mikey, who comments on proceedings through a wisecracking inner monologue. Mikey is confident the cab driver who helped deliver him is the perfect man for the job - but his mother is less than convinced. Comedy, with John Travolta, Kirstie Alley and the voice of Bruce Willis

Wisecracking toddler Mikey is joined by mischievous baby sister Julie and sibling rivalry inevitably erupts - while their parents have problems of their own to deal with, in the shape of the kids' good-for-nothing uncle. Comedy sequel, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley, with the voices of Bruce Willis and Rosanne Barr

A family takes in two pet dogs, a scruffy mongrel with discipline problems and a prim and proper pedigree poodle, whose personality clashes create all sorts of mayhem for the household. Comedy sequel, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley, plus the voices of Diane Keaton and Danny DeVito as the canine duo

Mercenary leader Barney Ross is recruited by the CIA to recover a top-secret package, only to come to blows with a rival band of hired guns. Barney swears revenge when the other faction kill his protege, and leads his men on a mission to stop their enemies taking over a former Soviet nuclear facility. Action thriller sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone and Jean-Claude Van Damme

Soldier of fortune Barney Ross discovers an old friend he was forced to kill is still alive, and has become a powerful arms dealer with vengeance on his mind. Barney is forced to recruit a new band of mercenaries and adopt more modern tactics to deal with this threat to him and his past associates. Action thriller sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone and Mel Gibson

A mercenary leads his elite team on a mission to assassinate a South American dictator, only to find their target is merely a pawn and the real power in the country is a rogue CIA agent. Feeling they have been double-crossed, they abandon the operation - but are compelled to return and save a captured rebel. Action thriller, directed by and starring Sylvester Stallone. With Jason Statham and Jet Li

A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score. Thriller, starring Zachary Levi, Liam Neeson and Quincy Isaiah

In 1917 New England, unassuming music student Lionel Worthing meets David White in a bar. There is an instant connection between men with a mutual interest in the history of folk music, and they spark a passionate affair, conducted behind closed doors. Historical drama, starring Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor and Chris Cooper

Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

As the Mongol Empire crumbles, a battle-scarred Timur Barlas must confront a haunting destiny and renounce his loyalties to protect the fate of the Silk Road. Action adventure, starring Christian Mortensen and Mahesh Jadu
Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

p.t: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie (2025)
p.d: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

A teenager breaks the world record for a video game depicting spaceship battles, unaware the game is based on a real interplanetary war and has been created as a test to recruit fighter pilots. When a besieged planet's entire fleet is wiped out, he is forced to take on an entire alien armada single-handed. Sci-fi adventure, starring Lance Guest and Robert Preston

A repairman is assigned to salvage the remaining resources from Earth, which has been left a devastated wasteland after a war with an alien race. He discovers a human survivor on the surface of the planet, an encounter that exposes secrets from the past that threaten the future of the human race. Sci-fi adventure, starring Tom Cruise and Morgan Freeman
A billionaire's death causes a bloody turn when an AI android built for human companionship goes haywire. Sci-fi horror, starring Jack Quaid, Sophie Thatcher Lukas Gage and Megan Suri

Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams

Five medical students conduct dangerous experiments to discover whether there is an afterlife by electronically inducing a near-deathlike state and then bringing about resuscitation at the critical moment. However, when they venture into real-death experiences, they unwittingly unleash supernatural phenomena linked to their past misdeeds. Thriller, with Julia Roberts, Kiefer Sutherland, Kevin Bacon, William Baldwin and Oliver Platt

Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams

After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones

Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez

Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

A girl is possessed by a formidable demonic entity that resists all efforts at freeing her from its grasp. In desperation, the child's mother appeals for help from a local priest and a veteran exorcist, but succeeding in this nightmarish contest of wills threatens the lives of both men. William Friedkin's horror, starring Linda Blair, Jason Miller, Ellen Burstyn, Max von Sydow and Lee J Cobb

Seventeen-year-old Andy and his visually impaired younger stepsister Piper discover their father dead in the shower. Single mother Laura agrees to take in Andy and Piper until the traumatised youngster comes of age and can apply for legal guardianship of his stepsister. Hoever, when events inside Laura's home spiral out of control, Andy fears he is losing his mind. Thriller, starring Billy Barratt, Sora Wong and Sally Hawkins
A family become convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs. Steven Soderbergh's horror thriller, starring Lucy Liu, Chris Sullivan, Callina Liang and Eddy Maday

A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

However, when they venture into real-death experiences, they unwittingly unleash supernatural phenomena linked to their past misdeeds. Thriller, with Julia Roberts, Kiefer Sutherland, Kevin Bacon, William Baldwin and Oliver Platt

When a besieged planet's entire fleet is wiped out, he is forced to take on an entire alien armada single-handed. Sci-fi adventure, starring Lance Guest and Robert Preston

After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

With the web-slinger's identity now revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for magical help to undo the damage. However, a spell gone wrong unleashes dangerous foes from parallel universes on the world. Comic-book adventure sequel, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya and Benedict Cumberbatch, with Willem Dafoe, Jamie Foxx and Alfred Molina among the stars of past Spider-Man movies reprising their roles

Conservationist Sergei Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai, sets him on a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become Kraven, the world's most feared hunter. Fantasy adventure, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Russell Crowe and Ariana Debose

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

While exploring space for new worlds, a probe belonging to the Life Foundation discovers a comet covered in symbiotic lifeforms. Following the probe's return to Earth, journalist Eddie Brock investigates sinister trials being carried out by the corporation, and after being infected by an alien symbiote, develops superhuman strength and power. Fantasy adventure, starring Tom Hardy and Riz Ahmed

In 1987, lonely Californian teenager Charlie Watson is traumatised by the death of her father and resentful of her mother Sally's relationship with new boyfriend Ronald. For her 18th-birthday she's given a yellow Volkswagen Beetle, which turns out to be the battle-scarred Autobot Bumblebee. Transformers prequel, starring Hailee Steinfeld, John Cena and Jorge Lendeborg Jr

The shape-changing robots and their human allies face a confrontation with their original creator, who has brainwashed their leader and intends to save her own home planet by destroying Earth. To save the human race they must recover an ancient artefact from Arthurian legend - but their mission is threatened by old enemies as they uncover a terrible secret about the history of the world. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mark Wahlberg, Anthony Hopkins, Gemma Chan, Stanley Tucci and John Turturro

Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage

Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of meta-humans to stand against supervillain Steppenwolf, but despite the help of Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash, it may already be too late to save the planet. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot and Henry Cavill

Hapless Sonny and his sidekick Sal have a plan to rob a Brooklyn bank. The novice crooks thought they would be in and out in 10 minutes, but instead find themselves stuck in an ongoing hostage situation, with the police and the media laying siege to the bank. Sidney Lumet's fact-based drama, starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning.

Tony Kiritsis is convinced mortgage broker ML Hall cheated him out of profits from a land development deal and he vows revenge. Tony walks into a branch of the Meridian Mortgage company for a meeting with ML, only to find his target is on holiday and the appointment will be with ML's son Richard instead. Regardless, Tony reveals a shotgun and holds Richard hostage for his father's supposed crimes. Director Gus Van Sant's thriller, starring Bill Skarsgård, Al Pacino and Dacre Montgomery

The skipper of a fishing boat and his crew ignore severe weather warnings and head for a dangerous area of the North Atlantic in search of the last lucrative catch of the season, but end up fighting for survival in the worst storm of the 20th century. Fact-based disaster drama, with George Clooney, Mark Wahlberg, Diane Lane, John C Reilly and Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio.

A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox

After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

The FBI agent who first captured Hannibal Lecter is called out of retirement to catch a demented murderer dubbed the Tooth Fairy, who slaughters a family whenever there is a full moon - forcing the detective to draw on the imprisoned cannibal's expertise in criminal psychology. Thriller prequel adapted from the first of Thomas Harris's Lecter novels, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton, Ralph Fiennes and Philip Seymour Hoffman

An unlicensed boxing promoter and his dim-witted sidekick convince a bare-knuckle champion to step in for their injured fighter, but find themselves drawn into a match-fixing racket. Meanwhile, the loot from a diamond heist goes missing, leading to a bloody conflict between Russian gangsters and a Jewish mob. Guy Ritchie's comedy drama, with Jason Statham, Brad Pitt, Benicio Del Toro and Stephen Graham

The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles

When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

Guy Ritchie's comedy drama, with Jason Statham, Brad Pitt, Benicio Del Toro and Stephen Graham

A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

Eric McCormack and Debra Messing star

Meanwhile, Jack fends off the advances of an amorous cop and Karen plays a high-society treasure hunt. Eric McCormack and Debra Messing star

Jack celebrates his one-month-aversary with cute cop Drew. The problem is, Drew is still married to Angela, but Jack has convinced her that he too is married - to Karen - so that they can continue to fool around behind her back. Meanwhile, Grace gets a spot on QVC trying to sell her bedsheets, though control freak Will immediately takes over, and the sheets hit the fan as their bickering is broadcast live on TV. Comedy, starring Eric McCormack and Debra Messing

The history course is overbooked, so Pelton makes the students compete for a place. Britta helps Abed cope with the thought of his friends leaving. With Fred Willard
Pierce locks himself in a panic room on Halloween. His friends try to get him out, and accidentally stumble on one of his family secrets
Grace wrestles with a newly wed dilemma - she only has two tickets for The Nutcracker on Christmas Eve, and cannot decide whether to take Will or Leo. Eric McCormack and Debra Messing star

Part one of four. Karen plays Cupid for Will, who soon finds his 'hot and handsome' date is a self-conscious misfit. Meanwhile, Grace worries her extrovert masseuse Julie may have more than a passing interest in her. American sitcom, guest starring Rosanna Arquette and Dan Futterman

Part two of four. Will recalls his own clumsy experience of coming out as he and Jack continue to turn Barry into the perfect gay man. Meanwhile, Grace feels abandoned when Leo offers his much-needed services as a medic in Africa

p.t: Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief (2015)
p.d: Alex Gibney's documentary, based on Lawrence Wright's book, sheds light on the controversial religious movement, from its roots in the mind of founder L Ron Hubbard through to its rise in popularity in Hollywood and beyond. The film also profiles eight former members of the Church of Scientology, including Oscar-winning screenwriter and director Paul Haggis, who offer their perspective on the actions of the organisation's leaders past and present

Documentary made to mark the 50th anniversary of the moon landings, presenting the story of the iconic space mission through a newly discovered trove of 70mm archive footage and still photographs and drawing on thousands of hours of audio recordings. Featuring the personal accounts of the astronauts, the team in Mission Control, and the millions of spectators on the ground

Documentary celebrating Bobby Moore, exploring his football career, including leading the England team to victory in the 1966 world cup, and the personal challenges he faced both on the pitch and in retirement. Featuring archive footage and contributions from family, friends and celebrity fans

Documentary charting the rise in violence, drug addiction and organised crime in Dublin from the 1980s to present day. Upon the arrival of Heroin on the streets of Dublin in the 1980s, Larry Dunne senses an opportunity
Documentary exploring a movie Steve McQueen began work on in the 1960s, but which was never completed
Shockwaves are sent across the country as crime reporter Veronica Guerin is shot in broad daylight by drug lords

The comedian and host of The Last Leg takes viewers behind the scenes of a global campaign to promote para-standing tennis and its potential as a future Grand Slam and Paralympic event. Adam meets and plays with former Grand Slam winners and uncovers the barriers faced by aspiring tennis players with disabilities who want to be included by their sport at the highest level
The life and work of Italian film-maker Sergio Leone, whose influential movies include A Fistful of Dollars, The Good, the Bad and the Ugly and Once Upon a Time in America

How, in Gold Rush California, Mexican immigrant Joaquin Murrieta formed a gang of outlaws that spread terror across the newly formed state. His legend as a hero to the downtrodden endured despite being hunted down by the California Rangers

How Kansas became a battleground in the US national debate over slavery. Settlers on both sides of the issue poured into the territory to determine its future as a free or slave state in its eventual admission to the Union

p.d: Jason Fox and Bruce Crompton explore a battlefield cornet, a medieval dagger and Second World War medic tins - artefacts drawn from museum collections, private archives and Bruce's own unrivalled holdings

p.t: Battle Treasures with Foxy and Bruce
p.d: Hidden compasses, the SAS silk map from the Bravo Two Zero mission, and resistance radios reveal the ingenious tools of wartime escape. Jason and Bruce uncover stories of survival.

Ten of history's most compelling - and covert - projects that study the UFO phenomenon. These range from clandestine government organisations to agents that silence UFO witnesses and secret programs to reverse engineer alien technology. Are these mysterious projects evidence of contact with extraterrestrials?

Ten mysterious mountains that are notorious for otherworldly phenomena. They include a summit in Sri Lanka that is said to be a portal to other worlds and a volcano in Washington that was at the heart of a UFO sighting

p.t: Greatest Prison Escapes with Billy Hayes
p.d: The presenter examines audacious jail and prison breaks, focusing on an instance when six inmates in a Tennessee jail smashed a rusted toilet through a bathroom wall, weakened during plumbing repairs, in order to escape on Christmas morning, 2016

The team members dig into artefacts from a Jamaican port sunk by a devastating earthquake. As they progress, they take a peek at a Minoan landmark and inspect a treasure trove of English relics

The great Cleopatra VII was not the only Egyptian queen to bear that name. This programme explores the shocking story of two other Cleopatras, who ruled Egypt jointly with Ptolemy VIII - a grim tale of incest, murder, rape, mutilation and war

Part one of two. In a parallel universe where the Enterprise is manned by an amoral crew, power-hungry first officer Archer mutinies against Captain Forrest, his lover Hoshi and slave T'Pol, to take full credit for an astonishing discovery. Celebratory episode commemorating 700 editions of the long-running sci-fi franchise

Part two of two. Having used the Defiant to repel a Tholian attack, the power-hungry Archer commandeers the advanced starship in an attempt to seize control of Earth's entire Terran empire. However, Hoshi, T'Pol and a reptilian Gorn stowaway are busy hatching schemes of their own. Sci-fi drama, starring Scott Bakula, Jolene Blalock and Linda Park

Part one of two. Archer and the crew attend a Starfleet conference, and unearth a xenophobic plot to rid Earth of alien influence. Meanwhile, T'Pol and Trip learn the conspirators have information about their child. Sci-fi drama, starring Scott Bakula, Jolene Blalock and Connor Trinneer

Part two of two. Archer and the crew try to stop Paxton, who is threatening to blow up Starfleet Command if they refuse to remove all aliens from Earth. Meanwhile, Trip and T'Pol come face to face with the baby girl created from their combined DNA - and realise she is in need of medical attention
Seven of Nine becomes engrossed in exploring her humanity on the Holodeck, neglecting her duties in the process. Sci-fi drama, starring Jeri Ryan
The omnipotent Q brings his rebellious son onto the ship to learn some discipline - but he proves even harder to handle than his unpredictable father
The holographic Doctor creates tension as the ship prepares to establish a new communication link which will give crew members a few minutes' contact with friends and family on Earth
Paris, Neelix and the Doctor are sent on an away mission to explore a planet devastated by nuclear radiation. Sci-fi drama, starring Robert Duncan McNeill and Robert Picardo

Chakotay and Seven are stranded among a primitive people when their shuttle encounters an energy barrier which prevents the ship's crew locating them, and the pair consider breaking the prime directive in a bid to escape. Meanwhile, Paris infringes local space flying regulations and receives an unusual punishment. Robert Beltran and Jeri Ryan star

When law-abiding space cop Ash Harper is convicted of a crime she did not commit, she is sentenced to exile and loaded onto prison spaceship the Hemlock. Her mother Rebecca, who is head of galactic security, is determined to prove her daughter's innocence and bring her safely home, but any hopes of a reunion are dashed when Ash's fellow convicts overthrow the guards and hijack the Hemlock. Sci-fi drama, starring Savannah Steyn and Natasha O'Keeffe

As the Hemlock fugitives set about salvaging their crash-landed ship, Ash makes her escape through an alien desert and makes an unwelcome acquaintance in the form of scruffy space-pirate Echo Nantu-Rose. Meanwhile, Rebecca's fears over her daughter's plight are compounded when she learns that terrorist organisation ARC was behind Ash's wrongful imprisonment

Drifting through space without the co-ordinates to Arcadia, the crew encounters another setback - the Hemlock is running out of power. Ash, Verona and Echo embark upon a race-against-time heist at Commonworld fuel reserve NAR-59, but with Dr Emma Grieves still aboard and her mission incomplete, Ash must aid and abet her fellow fugitives just enough to avoid suspicion - a strategy with devastating consequences

S2 E8 — For the Man Who Has EverythingRigsby jumps to the conclusion that Philip has bought him the kind of curvaceous Christmas cracker every man dreams of, but, as usual, his happiness is short-lived. Vintage 1975 seasonal special, starring Leonard Rossiter, Don Warrington, Richard Beckinsale and Gay Rose.
S3 E1 — That's My BoyRigsby returns from a dismal holiday in Spain to find a surprise awaiting him - the love of his life, Miss Jones, is back - with a baby in tow. Comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter.

S3 E2 — Stage StruckMiss Jones falls for new guest Hilary, a budding playwright who sends Rigsby into fits of jealousy by offering her the starring role in his latest masterpiece. Classic comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter and guest Peter Bowles.

S3 E3 — Clunk ClickRigsby splashes out on a new sports car in the hope of impressing Miss Jones, but a cruel practical joke by Philip convinces him he has run over his feline friend Vienna. Leonard Rossiter and Frances de la Tour star.

S3 E4 — The Good SamaritanGloomy new tenant Mr Gray moves into Rigsby's boarding house, but proves so depressed that he barely seems to notice the dingy surroundings, and keeps talking about 'going to a better place' - raising fears he is contemplating suicide. Classic comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter and David Swift.

S3 E5 — Fawcett's PythonTired of getting nowhere with Miss Jones, Rigsby switches his amorous attentions to new lodger Marilyn, who turns out to be an exotic dancer - complete with python. Classic comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter, Richard Beckinsale and Don Warrington.

S3 E6 — The Cocktail HourAlan starts dating a posh new girlfriend, but makes the mistake of asking Rigsby for advice on how to conduct himself in polite company - a sure-fire recipe for disaster. Comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter and Richard Beckinsale.

S3 E7 — Suddenly at HomeNew tenant Osborne seemingly dies after eating a bowl of Miss Jones' home-made soup, plunging the household into mourning - but Rigsby is the one who ends up being measured for a coffin. Classic comedy, starring Leonard Rossiter.

S3 E3 — I Won't Dance, Don't Ask MeChrissy needs a partner for the annual staff dance, so Robin takes lessons from Mrs Roper. Flat-sharing comedy, starring Richard O'Sullivan, Paula Wilcox and Brian Murphy.
S3 E4 — Of Mice and WomenRobin uses the threat of a roving mouse as an excuse to spend the night in Chrissy's bedroom. Comedy series, with Richard O'Sullivan.
S3 E5 — Somebody Out There Likes MeChrissy discovers she has an admirer, while Mr Roper thinks his wife is seeing someone else. Comedy series, with Richard O'Sullivan and Brian Murphy.

S3 E6 — We Shall Not Be MovedMr Roper plans to convert the flats into smaller dwelling units - but he has not bargained for Robin, Chrissy and Jo having a three-year lease. Comedy, starring Richard O'Sullivan.

S3 E7 — Three of a KindChrissy takes over Robin's poker game when he is rushed into hospital. Unfortunately, she does not fully understand the rules and puts the rent money at risk. Comedy, with Paula Wilcox and Richard O'Sullivan.

S4 E1 — Home and AwayChrissy and Robin borrow Mr Roper's car to drive to Southampton for a football match. However, the vehicle has similar qualities to its unreliable owner and soon breaks down leaving the duo having to summon help from an unexpected quarter. Comedy, with Richard O'Sullivan and Paula Wilcox.
S4 E2 — One for the RoadRobin regrets sampling Mr Roper's home brew when he is breathalysed during a driving lesson with Chrissy. Comedy series, with Richard O'Sullivan.

The wildlife of Antarctica, including king penguins that must evade leopard seals to feed at sea, albatrosses responding to diminishing number of females in their population and rare footage of the Antarctic blue whale, the largest animal to have ever lived. As the programme ventures into the heart of the continent, surprising footage reveals one of the most volcanic regions on Earth, with unexpected sand dunes hidden in a rare ice-free valley

The wildlife that inhabit the snow-covered forest and open tundra of the far north, including Arctic foxes that dig face first in the snow to hunt for lemmings and turtle hatchlings that stay frozen during winter, emerging from suspended animation in the first thaws of spring. Snowy owls take advantage of 24 hours of continuous daylight to hunt as much as possible. Plus, a look at how climate change is harming this environment by melting the permafrost deep within the soil

p.t: Vardy v Rooney: A Courtroom Drama

The origins of the dispute lay in a 2019 tweet in which Rooney publicly accused Vardy of selling stories to the press about her. With Natalia Tena, Chanel Cresswell and Michael Sheen

p.t: My Boyfriend, My Rapist: The Secret Footage
p.d: A young woman who stumbled upon devastating secret footage hidden on her own computer, which left her heartbroken and traumatised. Thirty-two year old Juliana Terlizzi discovered a set of videos of herself laying drugged and unconscious in her own bed, while her then-partner Hubert Greliak sexually assaulted her and filmed the act. This programme follows Juliana's quest for truth and justice

Documentary examining the murder of five-year-old Logan Mwangi, whose body was found dumped in a river just yards from his home in South Wales. With access to South Wales Police murder detectives as they arrest and question Logan's mother and her partner, the film follows the painstaking work of law enforcers as they try to prove who killed the youngster

A relative brings important news, and Nick is puzzled when Kate seems less than pleased to see her. Meanwhile, a wedding is thrown into confusion by a family death. Rural police drama, starring Nick Berry and Niamh Cusack

A lavish dinner party proves to be a prelude to murder and intrigue - but fortunately Poirot is among the guests, and soon realises the key to the mystery lies in a duel fought 10 years previously. Drama, starring David Suchet, Caroline Langrishe and John McEnery

The Belgian detective looks forward to a quiet Christmas, but is disturbed by the Foreign Office when an Egyptian prince loses a famous ruby - after making the mistake of lending it to a mysterious woman. Guest starring Stephanie Cole, Nigel Le Vaillant and Tariq Alibai
Archive news documentary looking back at the headline stories of the past 20 years, focusing this week on 2006

Charity's prison ordeal intensifies after a lockdown leads to a cell search. Chas demands a family meeting, where she and Mackenzie pressure Sarah to change her statement - leading to a clash with Cain, who is in full support of his granddaughter
Sadie manipulates Nicola, but is visibly shaken when she spots Cain, while Joe insists on a private funeral
Charles attempts to comfort a grieving Nicola, while Billy confronts Joe about the private funeral plans and Kev makes his opinion known.
Sadie drops a bombshell and has a hostile run-in with Kim, while Lewis is upset by an answer

Documentary following the daily work of Dyfed-Powys police officers over the busy summer months. Dyfed-Powys is the smallest police force in the UK, but has to patrol the largest police area, their jurisdiction taking in national parks and a lengthy run of the spectacular South Wales coastline. In this first episode, officers in the seaside town of Tenby on the western side of Carmarthen Bay have to deal with rowdy holidaymakers causing trouble and track down a pensioner who has been reported missing

Part two of two. The past catches up with Frost as he investigates a series of murders that appear to mirror crimes he failed to solve more than 16 years ago. As the case progresses, Mullett becomes convinced the detective's life is in danger, and with Jack now trying to bring two killers to justice - the copycat and the assailant at the dogfight - tragedy cannot be far ahead. David Jason stars, with Bruce Alexander, John Lyons, Phyllis Logan, Niamh Cusack, Adrian Dunbar, Leah Bracknell and Simon Shepherd

p.t: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
p.d: The chef rediscovers some wasabi plants in his kitchen garden, and decides to find out more, including how to grow them at the UK's only wasabi farm. Back on home turf, Marcus checks on his ducks and gathers up a glut of lavender to take to local gelato-maker, Grant

Ed kicks off his travel adventure in Cleveland, Ohio, visiting the iconic Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and exploring Playhouse Square, revealing a vibrant city filled with surprises. From art to cuisine and craft beer, Cleveland proves it's more than meets the eye

Ed visits Columbus, Ohio's state capital, and discovers the home of soccer in America. From exploring the vibrant arts scene in the Short North district to savoring local cuisine in German Village, he uncovers why Columbus is a hidden gem in the Midwest

Alex Polizzi visits a hotel located in six acres of Dorset countryside, complete with stables, an outdoor pool and a cricket pitch. The owners of the lodge have seen a steady decline in bookings since they stopped letting it for profitable functions, causing concern that the house may not be able to support them in the future. Alex believes, however, their long-serving assistant could help guide the venue to prosperity

While staff and pupils come to terms with Lorna's death, Jack is oblivious to the religious agenda a new buyer has planned for the school. The Head's healthy eating policy goes awry when a burger van starts selling junk food at the gates - which arouses suspicion when a youngster is rushed to hospital. Andrew agonises about a job offer in Rwanda. Angela Griffin and Jason Merrells star

Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot
Michael McQuaid is joined by guests for sharp NFL debate, bold predictions and the stories Irish fans are talking about
Exclusive access, player features and interviews, with insights from Head Coach Mike McCarthy
A review of the latest matches in Europe's premier club competition, plus a look ahead to forthcoming fixtures
The vocal competition continues to seek out exciting new singers based solely on their amazing voices, rather than their appearance
Stephen Mulhern hosts as a contestant tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize

Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which five contestants race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

Peter Andre's 60 Minute Makeover is back and bigger than ever on Quest Red. Peter and his army of helpers will be surprising deserving people across the country with a stunning home mkeover - performed in a day and brought to you in 60 minutes. In each episode one deserving person will get the surprise home makeover of a lifetime. Nominated by their friends and family they are everyday heroes with moving stories that tug at the heart.

Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000?

Leah is faced with her biggest challenge yet when one of her patients confesses that he wants to die. Angelo tries to keep up with a ward full of patients and Mikey thinks he has seen it all until a man comes in to A&E after being run over by his wife. Gina and Issie reflect on the huge progress their stroke patients have made

Superfan Hilary makes an 80-mile round trip to Cardiff to order her dream birthday cake and the shop's first anniversary party is almost ruined by a trip with showstopper in hand. Like Hilary, the people of Cardiff can't get enough macarons, cupcakes and treats, but the team are struggling to keep up with demand with so little space. The boys think they've found the ideal new base to expand - but it's a big business decision to take
Sophia Roe explores global socio-political and environmental issues through the lens of food and culinary trends

Bradley Walsh presents as Toby Anstis, Paula Radcliffe, Rav Wilding and Vanessa Feltz pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught
Deirdre O'Kane provides the voiceover as a selection of telly addicts comment on the week's programmes from the comfort of their living rooms
Jagaddhatri juggles her crime branch duties and secret identity while running an NGO. As cases pile up, her double life begins to unravel, testing her strength and the truth she hides.
Privileged Leela's cold world shifts when her father's grounded aide, Ram, arrives.
Radha, a devoted woman who values her marriage, moves to Mumbai. Her husband, Gary, betrays her with Shanaya, but she fights for his redemption and to save their marriage.
Deeming it a lucky charm, Vrinda marries Sanjay, who loves Divya. Serving as a caretaker in his home, she endures silent sacrifices, wondering if love will ever find her.
Posing as Lilly Mathew, Jagadhatri enters the Deshmukh house. Will she be able to uncover Rudra's hidden secret?
The family decides to drive Birju out after he attacks Chandrika. Vasudha decides to put forward a request.
Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

Lakshmi is married to Shriniwas Dalvi, who belongs to a traditional joint family. While she strives to navigate challenges, she supports her husband's dreams.
